annotations.title: Join an inbox with an invite link

description: Use an Inbin invite link someone sent you. Needs no credentials. Returns a claim_url: show it to the person; they enter the email the invite was made for and the code Inbin emails them, and the page then shows this agent's connection. Then wait with await_trial_inbox_claim (the token after /claim/) or check later with claim_connection_status. Returns invalid_link if the link is mistyped, used, revoked or expired; repeated invalid links are rate limited.
name: join_inbox
